_about: Output of rca_loadtest_summary.py --tenant <id> --timeframe <2h|30m|7d|START/END ISO8601>. JSON on stdout, progress/errors on stderr. All times UTC. Values are null when there is no data to compute them (e.g. no runs). 'Run' = one analyzer execution; per-run averages divide by the count of the matching log messages.
_sources: Davis analyzer execution logs (dt.rca.horizontal.* analyzers, filtered to the tenant; nested info messages analysis_finished / bfs_stats / events_fetched, plus warning messages) and DQL query logs of the Grail queries those analyzers issued. CPU time of a query = backend real_ns + frontend cpu_ns; cost = CPU seconds x 0.00004 DT$.
tenant: string - tenant id the data is filtered to

timeframe.seconds: int - window length; used for per-minute rates and cost extrapolation

pups.total: int - sum of `pups` in analysis_finished messages
pups.avgPerRun: number - total / number of analysis_finished messages

rcaEvents.total: int - open + bornClosed (assumes the two are disjoint)
rcaEvents.bornClosed: int - sum of `bornClosedRcaEvents` in bfs_stats (events created already closed)
rcaEvents.avgPerRun: number - total / number of analysis_finished messages

rootEventsFetched.total: int - sum of `events` in events_fetched (input events for the analysis)
rootEventsFetched.avgPerRun: number - total / number of events_fetched messages

runs.total: int - analyzer executions with a result status
runs.topWarningMessages: [{message: string, count: int}] - up to 10, most frequent first; messages are not normalised

durations.detector: {avgMs, maxMs} - per run, sum of detect.durationMs over all depths in bfs_stats

grailQueryCost.queries: int - number of analyzer DQL queries
grailQueryCost.totalCostDt: number - DT$ for the timeframe (CPU seconds x costRateDtPerCpuSecond)
grailQueryCost.extrapolatedCostDtPerYear: number - totalCostDt scaled to a year (assumes the timeframe is representative)
grailQueryCost.sharePctOfCost: {eventsSnapshots, smartscapeEdges, timeseries, other} - % of total CPU by query type (`fetch dt.davis.events.snapshots`, `smartscapeEdges`, `timeseries`, everything else)
grailQueryCost.sharePctByQueryType: {<type>: pct} - same, per query type (first DQL command or `fetch <data object>`), largest first

grailCpuTime.totalSeconds: number - CPU seconds of all analyzer DQL queries
grailCpuTime.requestQueries: timeseries queries on dt.service.request.* metrics: {queries, totalCpuSeconds, avgCpuSeconds, maxCpuSeconds, shareOfTimeseriesCpuPct, shareOfTotalCpuPct}
grailCpuTime.sharePctOfTotalCpu: {request, faas, messaging} - % of total CPU per family

timeseries.intervalSeconds: int - bucket width (~timeframe/60, whole minutes, min 60)
timeseries.from: ISO timestamp - bucket 0 starts here (may be slightly earlier since DQL aligns buckets)
timeseries.analysisDurationMs: {avg: number[], max: number[]} - per bucket, same source as durations.analysis; null = empty bucket
timeseries.detectorDurationMs: {avg: number[], max: number[]} - per bucket, same source as durations.detector; null = empty bucket
timeseries.requestQueryCpuSeconds: number[] - CPU seconds of each individual request timeseries query in chronological order; NOT bucketed, no timestamps
